name: projector-v3
description: Develop software through a readable model of its concepts, requirements, scenarios, relationships and decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and build from a conceptual model.
interface.longDescription: Explore accepted concepts, requirements and decisions; plan concrete model changes in Codex Plan mode; implement authorized model and code changes together; and check the result against current meaning.
defaultPrompt: Show the concepts, requirements and decisions that govern this behavior.
Plan the model artifacts and code changes for this feature.
Implement this fix and check it against the accepted model.
Review this implementation for contradictions and missing behavior.
